normalization.names: NFKD; casefold; remove Mn; non-alphanumeric to spaces; collapse spaces; preserve word order
normalization.evidence: NFKC; casefold; collapse spaces; preserve punctuation; split literal [...]

matching.assignment: only edges in all maximum-cardinality one-to-one matchings
matching.assets: same BOE and exact normalized alias intersection; generation type not used
matching.events: same BOE; equal nonempty complete asset sets; every asset on both sides must already be matched; no dropped extras
matching.actions: same BOE and matched event; any predicted evidence fragment contained in an accepted passage of that action; no attributes or targets used
matching.locations: same matched event and exact normalized raw name; no level or INE used
matching.unresolved: scored unresolved predictions FP and expected positive truth FN; never choose a tie
matching.excluded: non-applicable/non-scored truth excluded; predictions forced to excluded truth or connected only to excluded truth excluded; mixed ambiguity remains penalized

temporal.historical: matched prediction is one historical_contamination_fp; omitted truth is not FN
temporal.ambiguous: excluded from action extraction, attribution and P0; reported explicitly

attribution.event: all generation assets in the predicted event
attribution.unresolved: unknown references and components with no links reported; no invented assets; unmapped predicted assets retained as distinct prediction identities
attribution.exact_set: applicable matched current actions only; unresolved targets make set incorrect
attribution.pairs: current truth pairs globally; historical and unmatched predicted action pairs FP; absent current actions contribute all FN; excluded actions excluded

document_scope: explicit extraction_json.document_scope; failed/uncertain/missing is missing, incorrect on scored truth; no truth-based derivation
evidence_support: nonempty and ALL predicted fragments contained in owner-specific accepted truth passages, conditional on current action matching
p0: original review_queue before human intervention; historical warning TP/no warning FN; current warning FP/no warning TN; omitted history never FN; unresolved warnings unadjudicated

metrics.aggregation: corpus micro; no macro or global system accuracy
metrics.attributes: only applicable correctly matched pairs; action fields current only; expected NA excluded; missing prediction incorrect
metrics.zero_denominators: JSON null with reason; F1 null when precision or recall undefined; F1 zero when both defined and zero
metrics.false_warning_rate: FP / (FP + TN) over adjudicable extracted current actions

execution_record: reuse final_holdout_execution_record_v1 schema; no V1 scoring
publication: frozen truth and evaluator required; new output only; sibling staging; single writer; input integrity checked before publication
